# BETWEEN with a list includes both bounds
age BETWEEN (30, 40)

# BETWEEN with a quoted string
age BETWEEN '30,40'

# The quoted form trims its bounds
age BETWEEN ' 30 , 40 '

# List bounds may be quoted numbers on a number field
age BETWEEN ('30', '40')

# Bounds in the wrong order match nothing
age BETWEEN (40, 30)

# BETWEEN on a float field
height BETWEEN (1.6, 1.7)

# BETWEEN on a numeric field with a negative bound
balance BETWEEN '-50,0.10'

# BETWEEN on a date field
due BETWEEN ('2026-10-26', '2026-11-01')

# BETWEEN on a timestamp field with timestamps
created_at BETWEEN ('2026-10-20T11:00:00Z', '2026-10-27T09:30:00Z')

# Date strings are not timestamps, in BETWEEN either
created_at BETWEEN '2026-10-20,2026-10-27'

# BETWEEN on a lateral field
order_count BETWEEN (1, 2)
